cells.gaps: No ruling of the authority against a named organisation in the last three years has been found. ARCOD, which succeeds the CIL under organic law 038-2026/ALP, has its president and ten councillors named; no act of ARCOD has been found.
cells.note: The 2021 law is in force and the CIL has implemented it through communiques, reports and awareness sessions; ARCOD, its successor, had its president named on 16 October 2026 and its college on 19 November 2026. No ruling against a named organisation is on record, so the cell stops at 4.
